༄༅/ /lha mo nor rgyun ma'i sgrub thabs bsam 'phel dbang rgyal bzhugs/

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /lha mo nor rgyun ma'i sgrub thabs bsam 'phel dbang rgyal bzhugs/

na mo ba su dha ri ye/ lha mo nor rgyun ma sgrub par 'dod pas/ sangs rgyas chos tshogs ma'i sgo nas skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sogs sngon tu btang nas/ rang nyid skad cig gis lha mo nor rgyun mar gyur bar bsams/ /mchod pa yod na/ a mṛ tas bsang*/ swa bha was stong par sbyangs/ /stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du oṃ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo rnams dwangs shing thogs pa nam mkha' dang mnyam par gyur/ oṃ ar+ghaṃ āḥhūṃ nas/ shap+ta āḥhūṃ gi bar gyis byin gyis rlabs/ /tshogs zhing ni/ rang gi thugs ka'i baṃ yig las 'od zer 'phros/ /rang bzhin gyi gnas nas lha mo nor rgyun ma la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bh+yaḥ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ar+ghaṃ pra tī ts+tsha swā hā/ nas/ shap+ta'i bar gyis mchod/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ /nas/ sangs rgyas 'grub par shog/bar gyis skyabs sems bya/ /sems can thams cad bde ba dang ldan par gyur cig ces sogs kyis tshad med bzhi bsgom/ /tshogs zhing rnams rang la thim pas byin gyis brlabs par gyur par bsams/ oṃ swa bha was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las baṃ las sna tshogs pad+ma dang zla ba'i steng du baṃ ser po de las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can rnam kyi dbul zhing phongs pa'i sdug bsngal thams cad bsal/ srid zhi'i dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa thams cad bsdus te baṃ la thim/ /de yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid lha mo nor rgyun ma sku mdog gser btso lta bu/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ ral ba'i thor tshugs phyed thor cog tu bcings shing*/ phyed lan 'bur 'phyang ba/ phyag g.yas mchog sbyin dang*/ g.yon 'bras kyi snyem dang rin po rin po che'i bum pa 'dzin pa/

rin po che'i dbu rgyan/ snyan rgyan/ mgul rgyan/ phyag gdub/ zhabs gdub la sogs pa'i rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs pas brgyan cing*/ dar bzang po'i stod g.yogs dang smad g.yogs mdzes par gsol ba/ zhi zhing 'dzum pa sgeg pa'i nyams can/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis 'od kyi phung po'i dbus na bzhugs pa'i spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs khar hūṃ sngon po/ de las 'od zer 'phros rang bzhin gyi gnas nas lha mo nor rgyun ma la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par gyur/ slar yang thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ dbang gi lha rnams spyan drangs/ pañca kū la sa pā ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur tu gsol/ /zhes gsol ba btab pas/ /de rnams kyis bdud rtsi'i gang ba'i bum pa thogs nas/ oṃ sarba nas āḥhūṃ/ zhes gsungs shing*/ spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang*/ dri ma dag /chu lhag ma spyi bor gnas pa yongs su gyur pa las rin 'byung gis dbu brgyan par bsam/ oṃ ba su dhe ri ni sa pā ri wa ra ar+gha nas/ shap+ta pra tī ts+tsha swāhā'i bar gyis mchod/ /phun tshogs dge legs kun 'byung bcom ldan ma/ /dpal dang 'byor ba'i dbang phyug nor rgyun ma/ yid la re ba'i bkra shis stsol mdzad pa/ /bsam 'phel dkyil 'khor dbang phyug ma la bstod/ /rang gi thugs kar zla gdan gyi steng du baṃ yig gi mthar bzlas bya'i sngags kyis bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros/ /srid zhi'i dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa thams cad rgyal ba sras bcas kyi byin rlabs dang lhan cig 'od dang bdud rtsi'i rnam par spyan drangs nas/ rang gi thugs ka'i sngags phreng sa bon dang bcas pa la thim par gyur bar bsams la/ oṃ ba su dha ri ni swāhā/ oṃ shrī ba su ni dha na k+ṣe tre swāhā/

gnyis ka'am gang rung bzla/ bsnyen ched rab la nges pa ma mchis kyang*/ 'bring yig grangs sam/ sum 'bum/ tha ma 'bum phrag gcig bya'o/ /thun gyi mthar yig brgya gsum mam bdun bzlas/ /mchod bstod bya/ /gtor ma 'bul na/ /mar dkar ram zan las zlum gtor byas nas mar dkar bzhus te blug /yang na rin po che'i rigs dngos sam zan las nor bu'i dbyibs byas nas 'jog /byin rlabs ni/ a mṛ tas bsangs*/ swa bha was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+ruṃ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du oṃ las gtor ma dkar gsum mngar gsum zag pa med pa'i bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur par bsams la/ rang gi thugs ka'i baṃ yig las 'od zer 'phros zhes sogs tshogs zhing ltar spyan drangs la/ a kā ro lan gsum mam bdun dang*/ mtshan sngags kyi mthar pa ling ta btags la phul nas mchod cing bstod/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag la dpal dang 'byor ba phun sum tshogs pa'i dngos grub thams cad stsal du gsol/ /oṃ badz+ra muḥ gtor mgron rang gnas su gshegs par gyur/ /ces brjod cing bsam/ /smon lam gdab/ /spyod lam ni sha chang sogs la 'dzem zhing*/ gtsang sbra la gnas pa dang*/ rgyun du'ang lha mo'i sku dran bzhin par sngags bzlas na phun sum tshogs par 'gyur ro/ /ces nor rgyun ma'i mngon rtogs bsam 'phel dbang rgyal zhes bya ba 'di ni/ bka' bcu 'jam dbyangs don yod kyis bskul ba ltar/ bshad sgrub ming can gyis sbyar zhing*/ par du rko ba po ni blo gros ldan pa'i sngags 'chang tshe dbang rgya mtsho'o/ / sarba maṅgalaṃ// // mes po'i shul bzhag las/ co ne grags pa bshad sgrub kyi gsung 'bum/ lha mo nor rgyun ma'i sgrub thabs bsam 'phel dbang rgyal bzhugs/ - PAGE 188-- PAGE 189- -PAGE 186-
